images.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this original game ground texture into a refined sibling city-ground v2. Keep its exact muted cool-grey aged Chinese brick-and-stone material, directly overhead flat viewpoint, landscape 16:9 format, edge-to-edge traversable ground, diffuse lighting and all absence of objects/UI. Critical revision: the visible paving stones are MUCH too large for game characters. Replace the giant central slabs and all large border slabs with a much finer, consistent brick paving scale: roughly 35–50 small stones across the full image width, mostly horizontal rectangular bricks, with individual stone widths about 25–50 pixels in a 1672-pixel-wide image. No slab wider than 70 pixels; there must be no giant slab path in the center. Keep a subtle worn irregular path using wear and dust, not oversized stones. Lower the visual contrast of brick joints and tiny cracks by about one third and make overall value slightly darker; this is a quiet floor under action, not a photoreal noisy surface. Distribute shallow dusty patches and occasional tiny flat rubble asymmetrically. Everything is FLAT and passable; no walls, pillars, buildings, trees, steps, holes, raised blocks, large cracks, circles, runes, characters, text or HUD. Maintain hand-crafted restrained ARPG material quality with no blur, no glossy 3D plastic, no bright grass.

Add sparse very muted grey-green flattened moss/grass only in irregular small patches, never bright or olive-yellow. Limit all brown/yellow/ochre to almost zero: this MUST NOT look like an all-yellow dirt field. About 80 percent of the surface should have low visual variation and gentle edges; only a few faint flush paving joints and old shallow cart wear explain the road. Greatly simplify high-frequency detail: no dense pebbles, crack webs, sharp white chips, straw squiggles, gritty noisy texture or black outlines. Quiet hand-painted pixel-compatible material quality beside small raster characters; do not photorealistically emboss every pebble. Overall medium-dark cool grey with very narrow local brightness range, soft diffuse even light. Flat freely walkable floor fills every pixel edge-to-edge. Strict directly overhead orthographic view, no horizon, no sky, no perspective. No buildings, walls, pillars, tree trunks, raised rocks, tall vegetation, stairs, pits, water channels, standing props, objects, characters, circles, magical markings, UI, letters, borders, vignette, spotlight, or central arena.
